verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own case management feature: risk evaluation can route a transaction to review, and a reviewer opens the case in the Customer Area to accept or reject it. That covers the core review-queue workflow. However, nothing shows the case view surfacing full context such as customer history, triggered signals or similar cases. Shopper DNA links shoppers, but it is not documented as appearing in the review queue, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented in-case customer history, display of triggered rules or signals within the review view, similar-case surfacing, consistency or decision-support tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, flagged transactions land in a review queue that shows the full context — customer history, signals, similar cases — so I can decide quickly and consistently

citations.quote: The risk evaluation reaches a decision that results in an action to block, allow, or review the transaction.
A reviewer then accesses the case in the Customer Area and accepts or rejects the transaction.
